title: TDD header
description: The fenced yaml block at the top of tdd.md. Uses only the JSON Schema subset validate_doc.py implements: type, required, properties, items, enum, pattern, minItems, and if/then on a const.

architecture_owner.description: The person accountable for the design and for answering review questions.

status.description: draft while written, in-review once handed to reviewers; only a person sets accepted, changes-requested or declined.

reviewers.description: Names given by the owner. Never invented.

signed_off_by.description: Filled by the person who records the review decision.

signed_off_on.description: Date the review decision was recorded.

service_name.description: The service or component this TDD is for.

part.description: Only when the TDD is split: the part this file covers.

hla_link.description: Path to the accepted HLA, relative to this file.

trigger.description: Why a TDD exists: the review asked for it, an HLA impact flag requires it, or a stated override.

adr_links.description: ADR ids (or paths) this TDD relies on beyond the HLA's.

review_conditions.description: The HLA review conditions this TDD answers, copied from the HLA header.

exception_link.description: Where the approved exception is recorded, when the design departs from an accepted ADR.
